title: Ontology of Continua Core v1.4
description: This owner-review metadata describes the English public release bundle for Ontology of Continua Core v1.4. The bundle contains the release-ready master monograph, journal-facing extraction, public source files, proof and evidence summaries, replay and validation records, reviewer-response material, and package metadata. The folder path remains oc_core_1_3 as a source-series path; the current public version is resolved through releases/CURRENT_RELEASE.json. No Zenodo upload, DOI minting, GitHub release publication, journal submission, or public promotion action is performed by preparing this metadata.
